leading_candidate.hook_attempt: Tells you what a clock in this town actually read in 1911, and shows you the law that changed it.
leading_candidate.status: partially searched; not selected; not approved for implementation
leading_candidate.why_it_survived: The tz database's own documentation states it does not attempt accurate pre-1970 civil time, that most pre-1970 entries come from uncited sources, and that zones differing only before 1970 are merged into a file it calls less reliable. The gap is documented by the incumbent.
open_risks: Section 6 search is incomplete - github.com/dfl/tz_history and the genealogy, historical-GIS and historical-astronomy communities have not been searched.
Gate B is unsettled - whether primary sources for a chosen region and period can be lawfully obtained and read in this environment. Settle before committing, not at milestone four.
Scope honesty - much pre-1970 information was lost or never recorded, so a world-scale promise would repeat the C11 failure mode. Bound it to one region and period.

selection_state.do_not_start_implementation_until: W2 survives a proper Section 6 search and Gate B, or is rejected and wave three is generated in the three bands named in IDEAS.md.
